body.text: 1. Who we are
This website is operated by Think Positive Always ("Think Positive Always", "we", "us"). Full legal entity and contact details will be added to this policy before commercial services launch.
2. Information we collect today
At this stage, the website does not offer accounts, purchases, contact forms, or newsletter sign-ups, and we do not ask you to submit personal information through the site.

Like most websites, our hosting provider may automatically process limited technical information when you visit, such as your IP address, browser type, device information, and the pages you request. This is used to deliver the website securely and reliably.
3. Information we may collect in the future
As we introduce new features, we may collect:

items: Your email address if you subscribe to our newsletter.
Account details if you create a customer account.
Order information for digital product purchases. Payment details will be handled by a verified third-party payment provider; we do not intend to store full card details.
Messages you choose to send us.
Website usage analytics to help us improve content and performance.

body.text: This policy will be updated to describe each feature before it goes live.
4. Cookies
The website does not currently use advertising or analytics cookies. If we introduce cookies or similar technologies, we will update this policy and, where required, request your consent.
5. How we use information

items: To operate, secure, and maintain the website.
To provide services you request, such as newsletters or downloads, once available.
To understand how the website is used so we can improve it.
To comply with legal obligations.

body.text: 6. Sharing information

We do not sell personal information. We may share information with service providers who help us operate the website (for example, hosting, email, or payment providers), only as needed to provide their services.
7. Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict the use of your personal information. Details on how to exercise these rights will be provided here once contact channels are published.
8. Children
This website is intended for adults and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
9. Changes to this policy
We will update this policy as the website develops. The "Last updated" date above shows when it was last revised.
10. Contact
If you have questions about this document, please visit our [contact page](/contact) for the current ways to reach us.

Some links on this website may be affiliate links. If you click an affiliate link and make a purchase, we may earn a commission at no additional cost to you. We will only recommend products or services we believe may be genuinely useful to our readers.
Sponsored content and partnerships

Pages with affiliate recommendations show a disclosure next to those recommendations, and sponsored articles, banners and newsletter editions are labelled “Sponsored” with the sponsor’s name. Paid and affiliate links are marked as sponsored links for search engines.

cookies.summary: Which cookies and similar technologies this website uses, why we use them, and the choices you have.

notice.title: Draft — pending legal review
notice.text: This policy is a working draft. It has not been reviewed or approved by a legal professional, it has no effective date yet, and it may change before it is adopted. Items marked “Decision pending” are still to be decided by Think Positive Always.

body.text: 1. About this policy

This policy explains how thinkpositivealways.com uses cookies and similar technologies, such as your browser's local storage and session storage. It should be read together with our [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy).
2. Our approach in short

items: We do not use advertising cookies, advertising networks or social media tracking pixels.
We do not use Google Analytics or any other third-party analytics service.
With your permission, we count visits with our own usage statistics tool, which stores nothing on your device. You can accept or reject it, and change your mind at any time, in **Cookie settings**.
Cookies are only set when you sign in, and are used to keep you signed in securely.
A few features you choose to use (such as your cart) remember information in your browser's own storage.

body.text: 3. Strictly necessary cookies

These first-party cookies are set only when you sign in. They keep you signed in and protect your account against forged requests. They are not used for tracking or advertising, and the website's sign-in would not work without them, so they cannot be switched off in Cookie settings.

rows: Keeps a customer signed in to their account.
Until you close your browser, or 30 days if you choose “Keep me signed in”
Protects a customer's account actions against cross-site request forgery.
Keeps a member of our team signed in to the admin area.
Renews a team member's sign-in securely.
Protect admin actions against cross-site request forgery.
body.caption: Durations are the website's default settings. Only people who sign in receive these cookies.

body.text: 4. Information stored in your browser for features you use

Some features remember your choices in your browser's local storage or session storage. This information stays in your browser, is not sent to us automatically, and is used only for the feature concerned. Session storage is cleared when you close the tab.

rows: Local storage, until you change your settings or clear your browser's storage
Remembers the items in your cart.
Local storage, until you remove them or clear your browser's storage
Remembers the display currency you chose for prices.
Local storage, until you change it or clear your browser's storage
Keeps announcements you have closed hidden.
Local storage, until you clear your browser's storage
Remembers your course reader settings, such as text size and spacing.
Local storage, until you change them or clear your browser's storage
Keeps a backup of a course assignment answer while you write it.
Local storage, until the answer is submitted or cleared
Lets you return to an order you placed without an account.
Session storage, until you close the tab
Holds the access code from your purchase link while you view your purchases.
Session storage, until you close the tab

body.text: 5. Usage statistics

To understand which pages are read and improve the website, we count page visits with our own tool. It does not use cookies and stores nothing on your device. When you open a page, your browser sends us the page address, the page you came from and, for campaign links, the campaign labels in the link.

items: We do not store your IP address or your browser's details. To count unique visitors per day, we create a short code from a shortened version of your IP address, your browser's details and a random value that is replaced every day, so visits cannot be linked from one day to the next.
Visits are not recorded on private pages, such as your account, checkout or the admin area.
We respect your browser's Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control signals: when either is on, no visit is counted.
The statistics are not used for advertising, are not sold or shared, and are not combined with your account.
By default, individual visit records are deleted after 90 days and summary figures after about two years.

body.text: Usage statistics are optional. We ask for your permission before counting your visits, and you can switch them off, or back on, at any time in **Cookie settings**.
6. Third-party content and services

items: **Videos.** Some articles include YouTube or Vimeo videos. They load only when you press play, using YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode and Vimeo's do-not-track option. Once a video loads, the provider may use cookies or similar technologies under its own privacy policy.
**Payments.** When you pay for a purchase, you are taken to the secure payment page of our payment provider, Paystack. Paystack may use cookies on its own website under its own policies.
**Links to other websites.** Other websites you visit from our links have their own cookie and privacy policies.

body.text: 7. Your choices

items: Use the **Cookie settings** link at the bottom of every page to see and change your choices.
You can also block or delete cookies and stored information in your browser's settings. If you block strictly necessary cookies or storage, signing in, your cart and some other features may not work.
Turning on Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control in your browser also switches off usage statistics.

body.text: 8. Changes to this policy

We review this policy whenever we add or change a technology that uses your device. If a change affects your choices, we update the version shown in Cookie settings and, where required, ask you again.
9. Contact
Questions about this policy? Please visit our [contact page](/contact) for the current ways to reach us.

editorial.summary: How we research, write, review and correct what we publish, and how we keep our editorial work independent.
editorial.meta_description: How Think Positive Always researches, reviews and corrects its articles, uses AI tools, handles sponsored content and listens to readers.

notice.title: Draft — pending legal review

body.text: 1. Our editorial mission

Think Positive Always publishes practical, encouraging writing about mindset, personal growth, well-being, relationships and everyday life. We aim to be honest, useful and kind: to help readers think clearly and take small, realistic steps, without overpromising.
2. What we publish, and what we don't

Our articles offer general information, reflection and encouragement. We do not provide medical, psychological, legal, financial or other regulated professional advice. Where a topic needs specialist knowledge, we either have the content reviewed by a suitably qualified expert or we do not cover it. See our [Disclaimer](/disclaimer).
3. Research and sourcing standards

items: We prefer primary sources and reputable organisations, and we link to the sources that support factual claims.
We make clear what is evidence, what is opinion and what is personal experience.
We do not present a single study as settled fact, and we check that information is current.
Personal stories are shared with the permission of the people involved, or changed so that they cannot be identified.
We do not invent quotes, people, experiences or sources.

body.text: 4. Factual accuracy and editorial review

Before an article is published, it is read for accuracy, clarity, tone and fairness. Our publishing tools include a submit-and-approve review step. When we make a material update to a published article, we show the date it was updated.
5. Corrections

If we get something wrong, we correct it as quickly as we can. Where an error is significant, we make clear that the article has been corrected. To report a possible error, please tell us the page and what you believe is wrong through our [contact page](/contact).
6. AI-assisted content

We may use AI tools to help with tasks such as research, outlining, editing or checking readability. A person writes or substantially shapes every article, reviews it, and takes responsibility for it before it is published. We do not use AI tools to invent quotes, experiences, sources or people.

body.title: Decision pending
body.text: Confirm which AI tools are used and for what, and whether articles or images created with AI assistance will carry a visible label.
7. Editorial independence

Our editorial decisions are our own. Advertisers, sponsors and affiliate partners do not decide what we cover, cannot buy a positive review, and do not see or approve independent articles before they are published.
8. Sponsored content and affiliate links

Sponsored articles, newsletter editions and banners are labelled “Sponsored” with the sponsor's name, and affiliate links are disclosed. Sponsored content may be prepared with the sponsor, but it still has to meet our standards. See our [Advertising & Sponsored Content Policy](/advertising-policy) and [Affiliate Disclosure](/affiliate-disclosure).
9. Reader feedback
We welcome feedback, ideas and disagreement. We read every message sent through our [contact page](/contact), although we cannot always reply individually.
10. Contact
Questions about this policy? Please visit our [contact page](/contact) for the current ways to reach us.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.summary: Our commitment to making Think Positive Always usable by as many people as possible, and how to tell us about a problem.
accessibility.meta_description: The accessibility standard Think Positive Always works towards, what we have checked so far, known limitations and how to report an issue.

notice.title: Draft — pending legal review
notice.text: This policy is a working draft. It has not been reviewed or approved by a legal professional, it has no effective date yet, and it may change before it is adopted. Items marked “Decision pending” are still to be decided by Think Positive Always.

body.text: 1. Our commitment
We want everyone to be able to read and use Think Positive Always, including people who use a keyboard, a screen reader, magnification or other assistive technology.
2. The standard we work towards
We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA. The website has not yet been independently audited, so we do not claim that it fully meets this standard.
3. What we have checked so far

items: A “Skip to content” link is available at the top of every page.
Menus, dialogs and forms can be used with a keyboard, and our automated tests check that they work this way and have accessible names.
Pages use headings and landmarks, so assistive technology can move around them.
Videos load only when you choose to play them, using a labelled button.
Course readers can adjust text size, line spacing, width and colour theme.
Several animations are reduced when your device asks for reduced motion.

body.text: 4. Known limitations

items: We have not yet tested the website with a full range of screen readers, browsers and assistive technologies.
Downloadable files such as PDFs have not been checked for accessibility.
Embedded YouTube and Vimeo players are provided by those services, and we cannot change their accessibility.
Image descriptions are written by our editors, and some images may still be missing a useful description.

body.text: 5. Reporting an accessibility problem

If something on the website is difficult to use, please tell us through our [contact page](/contact). It helps to include the page address, what you were trying to do, and the device, browser or assistive technology you use. If you need content in a different format, let us know and we will try to help.

body.title: Decision pending
body.text: Decide whether to commit to a response time for accessibility reports.
6. Ongoing improvements
We review accessibility as we build new features and fix problems as we find them. We plan to have the website reviewed independently and will update this statement with the results.
7. About this statement
This statement was prepared on 9 November 2026 from our own review of the website. It has not been verified by an independent auditor.

If you believe material on this website infringes your copyright, please contact us through our [contact page](/contact) with:

items: a description of your work and the page address where the material appears;
your name and contact details;
a statement that you believe in good faith that the use is not authorised, and that the information you provide is accurate and that you own the rights or are authorised to act for the owner.

body.text: We will review your concern under applicable law, including Kenya's Copyright Act, and remove or change the material where appropriate. If you believe something was removed in error, please contact us.

We collect information only when you use a feature that needs it:

To reply to partnership inquiries and manage partnerships.
To provide your account, deliver your purchases and courses, send order and account emails, and handle refunds and support.

5. Cookies, browser storage and usage statistics

We use only the cookies needed to keep you signed in and protect your account, and a few entries in your browser's storage for features you choose, such as your cart. We count page visits with our own statistics tool, which uses no cookies and stores nothing on your device. Statistics are optional: you can accept or reject them, and change your mind at any time, in **Cookie settings** at the bottom of every page. Full details are in our [Cookie Policy](/cookie-policy).

items: Usage statistics: by default, individual visit records are deleted after 90 days and daily summaries after about two years.
Newsletter: until you unsubscribe or ask us to delete your details. When your details are deleted, a one-way coded form of your email address is kept so that we never email you again.
